qa_pair.question: In the owner's Business inventory, how many items currently have the status Sold? Answer with a number.
Which inventory item sold for the highest price? Answer with its UID (e.g. INV-2026-000).
Counting only items that have a sold price, which category has produced the most realized net profit (sold price minus buy price minus parts)? Answer with the category name.
What is the total realized net profit, in dollars, of Phone-category items that have a sold price? Answer with the number only (e.g. 1234.56).
How many Pokemon-category items are in Active status? Answer with a number.
How many Phone-category items have a sold date in April 2026? Answer with a number.
Which item had the most money invested in parts? Answer with its UID.
List the UIDs of all items with status Listed, sorted ascending and joined by commas with no spaces.
Within the Gaming category, which status do the most items have? Answer with the status name.
Across all items that have a sold price, what is the total realized net profit in dollars? Answer with the number only.
